description: Fires when column 0 is the urgent move, above all when the opponent has three of their stones stacked on top of column 0 with the cell above empty (a vertical must-block in column 0); strongest right after they play the third stone. Weaker firing: a non-vertical must-block or my own immediate win in column 0 at row 2-3. Vertical threes in other columns, my own column-0 three, and low horizontal threats to column 0 do not fire it.
effect: Pushes the model's move toward column 0: forced high it raised col 0 from 0.12 to 0.93 and from 0.01 to 0.45 in non-forcing positions (taken mostly from the favoured centre move); zeroing cuts col 0 by about 0.05-0.11. When the block is already certain it changes nothing.
notes: Core rule (opponent vertical three on top of col 0) alone: F1 0.465 with precision 0.96. Adding col-0 wins/blocks at rows 2-3 gives the best F1, 0.554 (P 0.82, R 0.42), sim share 0.65. About 60% of firing is a weak, diffuse tail (act 2.3-9), often after the opponent drops a stone into column 0 in midgame when col 0 is the engine's best move; no clean board rule for it (last-move-in-col-0 rules hurt precision). The synthesis position reaches 40.4, above the dev max.
